| `getAllScriptNames()` | Gets a list of all available script names |
| `getTotalInstances(int scriptId)` | Get the total number of instances purchased (or trialed) to a user for a script |
| `hasPremiumScript(int productId)` | Checks if the current user has access to a premium script |
| `hasPurchasedScript(int productId)` | Checks if the current user has an active purchase of a premium script |
| `hasSDNScript(int scriptId)` | Checks if the current user has access to an SDN script |
| `stop()` | This will force stop the current script running, including killing the thread if necessary. |
| `stopWithScheduledStop()` | This will attempt to stop the current script nicely by blocking up to 5 minutes until AbstractScript.onScheduledStop() returns true. |


| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `addNodes(TaskNode ... nodes)` | Add nodes to task list. |
| `getLastTaskNode()` | Gets the last task node that has been found valid to be executed. |
| `getNodes()` | Get task list nodes as an array. |
| `onLoop()` | See AbstractScript.onLoop() Checks all accepted nodes and executes the one with the highest priority value If no nodes are found, failCount is incremented by 1 If failCount goes above the failLimit, the script will stop. |
| `removeNodes(TaskNode ... nodes)` | Remove select nodes from task list. |
| `setFailLimit(int failLimit)` | Sets the amount the node selector is allowed to fail before stopping the script. |
